description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified resource pool
name: GetPool

parameters.help_en:
The name of the resource pool.

The name can be up to 15 characters long.

The name can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and periods (.)
parameters.help_zh:
资源池名称。
长度不超过15个字符。
可包含数字、大写字母、小写字母、下划线（_）和点（.）
parameters.name: pool_name

PoolInfo.description_en: The details of the resource pool

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the resource pool was created

ExecutorUsage.description_en: The number of executors that are in use in the resource pool
ExecutorUsage.description_zh: 在一个资源池内正在运行的执行节点用量

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the resource pool is the default resource pool. Valid values:

true

false
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否是默认资源池。取值说明：

true：是
false：否

MaxExecutorNum.description_en: The maximum number of concurrent executors per user in the resource pool
MaxExecutorNum.description_zh: 用户在一个资源池内允许并发运行的执行节点数量限制

PoolName.description_en:
The name of the resource pool.

The name can be up to 15 characters long.

The name can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and periods (.)
PoolName.description_zh:
资源池名称。
长度不超过15个字符。
可包含数字、大写字母、小写字母、下划线（_）和点（.）

Priority.description_en:
The priority of the resource pool.

Valid values: 1 to 99. A larger value indicates a higher priority. Default value: 1.

Jobs in a resource pool with a higher priority are scheduled before pending jobs in a resource pool with a lower priority. The priority of the resource pool takes precedence over the priority of a job
Priority.description_zh:
资源池的优先级。

优先级可设置范围：1~99。默认值为1，即最低优先级。
提交到具有较高优先级层级值的资源池的作业将在较低优先级层级值的资源池中的挂起作业之前进行调度，资源池的优先级层级优先于作业的优先级

SchedulingPolicyId.description_en: The ID of the scheduling policy

Status.description_en:
The status of the resource pool. Valid values:

`Creating`: The resource pool is being created.

`Updating`: The resource pool is being updated.

`Deleting`: The resource pool is being deleted.

`Working`: The resource pool is active.

`Deleted`: The resource pool has been deleted
Status.description_zh:
资源池状态。取值范围：

Creating：资源池创建中
Updating：资源池更新中
Deleting：资源池删除中
Working：资源池工作中
Deleted：资源池删除完成

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the resource pool was last updated
